subject.title: feat(browser): add GPT-5.6 Sol model aliases

question: Should Oracle expose `gpt-5.6` as a moving browser alias while guaranteeing `gpt-5.6-sol` remains pinned to the Sol picker entry?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but future retargeting of a public CLI identifier is a durable compatibility policy that requires project-owner intent.

options.title: Approve both alias contracts
options.body: Keep both aliases and explicitly document that the family alias may move while the Sol alias remains pinned.

options.title: Ship only the pinned alias
options.body: Remove `gpt-5.6` for now and expose only `gpt-5.6-sol` until a future default transition demonstrates the need for a moving alias.

options.title: Defer first-class aliases
options.body: Continue accepting explicit ChatGPT labels until the project adopts a broader browser-model alias policy.

recommendation.title: Approve both alias contracts
recommendation.body: Keep both aliases and explicitly document that the family alias may move while the Sol alias remains pinned.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history ownership across the picker, alias configuration, and CLI routing files and is best positioned to authorize the public compatibility contract.
